chunks: Said: 'These are my guests, so do not put me to shame.'

key_terms.تَفْضَحُونِي: do not put me to shame / expose me

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Lot say to protect his guests from the people of Sodom?
ai.summary: In the Tafsir tradition, this verse highlights the virtue of *diyafah* (hospitality) as a sacred duty, where Lot prioritized the safety of his guests over his own family's honor. Shia scholars often note that while he offered his daughters to appease the mob, it was a temporary measure to preserve the primary guests, illustrating the hierarchy of rights in Islamic jurisprudence.
